inputs.text: A vivid 1940s calendar-poster painting in a low-angle close-up composition, large heroic figures filling most of the frame, deep cobalt blue and crimson red with bright white highlights, hard glossy airbrushed modelling, intense saturated colour, dramatic and polished. Scene: A low-angle view up at an olive-drab American C-47 transport parked on a grass airfield outside Beiping at dawn, only a small blue-and-white sun roundel of the Chinese air force on its fuselage and nothing else painted on it, a long line of Nationalist soldiers in steel helmets and padded khaki uniforms with rifles and bedrolls climbing the ramp, an American crew chief in a flight jacket helping them up, more C-47s lined up behind in golden mist, wooden crates and jeeps beside them. China, October 1945, American-built C-47 in olive drab metal, not painted in flag colours, no jets. Full-bleed image that runs to all four edges of the canvas: no border, no frame, no margin, no white edge, no vignette, no title, no caption, no slogan, no signature, no lettering of any kind anywhere.
